summary: Phase 2 — Export & Editor Extensions: DOCX export (F-003) + TipTap table/math/callout extensions (F-005)
approach: Two-wave execution. Wave 1 installs dependencies and builds all TipTap editor extensions (table, math inline, math block, callout) with slash command integration. Wave 2 builds the DOCX export pipeline on top of the new node types, extends the export dialog, and wires multi-chapter export.
